Subject: Audit & access log retention/export options for Finvero

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Quick follow-up from our compliance review: our security team needs a succinct breakdown of Redwood's audit & access log retention windows and the supported export mechanisms for evidence handover. Specifically Finvero needs:

- A retention "matrix" showing default retention by log type (audit events, access traces, API request logs) and any paid/enterprise retention bumps.
- Export formats you support (CSV, JSON, syslog streams, bulk archive) and delivery methods (S3, signed FTP, on-prem shuttle).
- Typical SLA / lead times for large bulk exports (e.g., 30GB, 1TB).
- How deletion/erase is handled post-export (proof-of-erase options).

Can you send a short checklist/playbook we can hand to our legal/compliance folks? We have a deadline next Wednesday for the SOC gap review.

Thanks,

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. High-level answers below; I attached a concise playbook and a retention matrix CSV for Finvero's review. If helpful I can convert the matrix to your internal template.

Summary (short):
- Retention tiers: default (90 days), extended (1 year) for paid plans, and archived (up to 7 years) under Dedicated/Private with add-on.
- Log types: audit trails (control plane events), access traces (token/session-level), API request logs (request/response metadata). Each is exportable in JSON/NDJSON and CSV.
- Delivery methods: S3 (preferred, presigned), SCP/SFTP, signed HTTPS bulk download, and secure physical transfer for air-gapped requests.
- SLA for exports: small (<=50GB) typically 24–48 hours; medium (50–500GB) 2–5 business days; large (>500GB) handled via project plan — expect 5–14 business days depending on indexing and packaging requirements.
- Erase proof: we provide manifest of exported objects and a signed deletion attestation when requested for assigned retention windows.

Playbook highlights (attached):
- Checklist for submitting an export request (fields we need, encryption preferences, destination).
- Recommended retention policy mapping for regulated customers.
- Template manifest and sample index file.

I'll paste a compact retention matrix below for quick scanning. If you want, Marissa and I can hop on a 30-min call to walk Finvero's compliance team through the playbook.

Retention matrix (condensed):
- Audit trails (control plane): default 90d; extended 1y (paid); archived 7y (Dedicated/Private). Format: NDJSON/CSV.
- Access traces (token/session): default 90d; extended 1y for support/legal hold; archived subject to capacity. Format: NDJSON/CSV.
- API request logs (ingest metadata): default 30d; extended 90d/1y available. Format: JSON/CSV.

Next steps: share any compliance template you want the CSV converted into; confirm export destination (S3 preferred).

Best,
Tessa Morgan

Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. A couple of clarifications from our end:

1) We will need a signed deletion attestation after export for the 90-day default logs if Finvero requests a full handover and subsequent purge. That should be on company letterhead; can Redwood provide that?
2) For exports >500GB we prefer S3 presigned with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS). Can you confirm KMS integration options and whether we can provide our KMS ARN?
3) We do expect one EU-only export in June. Please note that the dataset will include PII and must not leave the EU region during packaging.

If you can answer the three points (attestation, KMS, EU-only process) we'll sign off on the request form and provide a target S3 bucket.

Regards,
Samir

Subject: Re: Audit & access log retention/export options for Finvero

Samir — answers inline and next steps below.

1) Signed deletion attestation: yes, we provide a signed attestation on Redwood letterhead after exports and after a confirmed purge. The playbook includes the attestation template (page 6). We can escalate to Legal for a stamped copy if your procurement needs it.

2) KMS integration: we support SSE-KMS to customer-managed KMS for S3 destinations. Please provide the KMS ARN on the export request form; our packaging job will encrypt with your key and will not keep the unencrypted bundle in our long-term storage. For very large exports we also support client-side encryption prior to transfer.

3) EU-only export: confirmed — we can run region-bound packaging. For EU-only exports we:
  - Stage data on EU-region staging nodes only
  - Apply region tag in the manifest and ensure all packaging completes in-region
  - Deliver via presigned S3 or SFTP hosted in the EU region

Next steps (recommended):
- Samir, if you can fill the attached export request form and indicate KMS ARN + destination bucket, we'll triage the job and confirm ETA.
- Karthik / Marissa: please include the two additional playbook rows (legal-hold, region-bound export) and push an updated XLSX to Samir by EOD Monday.

I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough if Finvero wants detailed handover steps.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan

Redwood Inference
